title: Pyaare nabi ki
body:
Pyaare nabi ki
<<MINI>>

<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaare nabi ki pyaari nawaasi
<<MINI>>

(Dekh rahi he koi to aaye, shaana pakar kar kaash bithaaye) x2

(Pyaare nabi ki pyaari nawasi, Shaam ko qaidi ban ke chali hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Bhaai bhateeje bhaanje bete, Saath watan se aayi thi lekar) x2

(Pyaare nabi ki pyaari nawasi, Shaam ko qaidi ban ke chali hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Beton ko sadqa bhaai pe karke, jisne kiye the shukr ke sajda) x2

<<MINI>>
(Pyaare nabi ki pyaari nawasi, Shaam ko qaidi ban ke chali hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Jiski kaneezein nikle na baahar, balwe mein laaye usko sitamgar) x2

<<MINI>>
(Pyaare nabi ki pyaari nawasi, Shaam ko qaidi ban ke chali hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Kitne hi qaidi jitney churaye, aaj woh bibi sar ko jhukaaye) x2
Eik rida ki ban ke sawali, Shaam ko qaidi ban ke chali he
<<MINI>>
(Pyaare nabi ki pyaari nawasi, Shaam ko qaidi ban ke chali hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Socho woh manzar "sarwar-o-rehan", bhaai ho jiska waarise quran) x2
Kaise woh bibi ashk bahaati, Shaam ko qaidi ban ke chali he
